sources: Google Maps place 'Georgia International Horse Park RV Campground' (33.6581,-83.9326; 4.9 stars, 13 reviews; phone 770-860-4190), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.georgiahorsepark.com/p/getinvolved/parking ('Fully equipped with water, electric and sewer service, these 140+ sites'); Main RV Lot Map legend ('50 AMP Hook-up & Water', '50, 30, 20 AMP Hook-up, Water & Sewer', '30, 20 AMP Hook-up, Water & Sewer'); 2026 registration form ('30AMP Service / 50AMP Service'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: '140+ sites' in the Main RV Lot (near the Stable Complex and Walker Arena) and the Barn 6 RV lot; the lot map mixes water+electric sites with full-hookup ones. No site lengths published.

sites.source: https://www.georgiahorsepark.com/p/getinvolved/parking ('these 140+ sites are located near the Stable Complex and the Walker Arena Complex'; 'Main RV Lot', 'Barn 6 RV Lot'); Main RV Lot Map, read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.georgiahorsepark.com/p/getinvolved/parking ('Full-service shower facilities are also located within the RV Park and their use is included in the daily RV site rental fee'); Main RV Lot Map ('Dump Station'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Event and show guests book through the event promoter. Anyone else calls the Horse Park office (770-860-4190, Mon-Fri 8-5) in advance; availability depends on the show schedule.

booking.source: https://www.georgiahorsepark.com/p/getinvolved/parking ('Individuals looking to overnight at the Horse Park, but not associated with a particular event, may contact our office directly. Due to limited capacity and show schedules, you must call in advance (770-860-4190) and reserve your space. Availability is determined by scheduled events.'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $32 a night per RV, 30- or 50-amp, on the park's 2026 registration form; showers included. No weekend or seasonal difference published.

note: City of Conyers' Georgia International Horse Park (1996 Olympic equestrian venue). RV lots by the stable and Walker Arena complexes. General RV park, not horse-only: non-event guests take nightly stays by phone, subject to the show calendar. --Claude
summary: Inclusion holds: the operator's RV Parking page takes non-event overnight guests by phone and the 2026 registration form posts $32 a night per RV (a public, posted rate), so it is not event/horse-only. Confirmed 140+ sites, water/electric/sewer (30/50 A), showers included, dump station; added the $32 rate and electric 50; platform phone. Note trimmed of hookups/count/showers. Pin is ~1.7 km off - see flag.
flags: Pin ~1.7 km off: stored 33.67158,-83.94109 is in a field north-west of the Horse Park. The operator's 'Main RV Lot' Street View link is at 33.6577,-83.9332 and Google's RV Campground place at 33.6581,-83.9326; imagery shows the gravel RV lot there at the south end of the stable complex.
